# PAYGW API

[![CI](https://github.com/acme-org/paygw-api/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/acme-org/paygw-api/actions)

Payment gateway API for Acme. Maintained by John Doe (@jdoe) and Jane Smith (@jsmith-acme).

## Run

    pip install -r requirements.txt
    uvicorn app.main:app --reload
